methodology.scope: A-share broad-market ETFs classified by explicit benchmark-name rules
methodology.shareChange: current exchange-reported shares minus prior reported trading-day shares
methodology.amount: share change multiplied by same-day unadjusted ETF close; estimated primary-market net subscription amount
methodology.sseUnit: SSE TOT_VOL is reported in 10,000 shares and converted to shares
methodology.szseUnit: SZSE 基金规模(份) is used directly as shares
methodology.anomalyRule: records with absolute one-day share change >= 50% or missing close are excluded from aggregates and retained in detail
methodology.caveat: estimated amount is not exchange cash settlement, turnover, or main-force flow; classification and corporate-action flags require periodic review
methodology.rebuildMode: reclassified from previously collected fund-level observations
